investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pixforge Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure centralindia (zones centralindia-1/centralindia-2/centralindia-3); network range 10.176.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pixfor-prod-centra (AKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic billing-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer billing-api, consumer search-api; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
